model_annotation: The bar chart displays the effect sizes of various models across different language families and isolated language groups, with error bars indicating variability. The horizontal axis categorizes the data by language family, including IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic. The vertical axis, labeled "effect," ranges from 0 to 30. For each language family, multiple models are compared, represented by different colored bars: mBERT-L₂ (light blue), XLM-L₂ (dark blue), mBERT-R₂ (light green), XLM-R₂ (dark green), mBERT-B₂ (light red), and XLM-B₂ (dark red). The chart shows that the effect sizes vary significantly across models and language families. For instance, in the IE-Indic family, the mBERT-R₂ and XLM-R₂ models show the highest effect sizes, both exceeding 20, while in the Uralic family, all models have very low effect sizes, generally below 5. The error bars, which represent standard error or confidence intervals, are present for all bars, indicating the uncertainty in the effect estimates. The legend in the upper right corner clarifies the color coding for each model.
